## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Audience and impact

Who benefits from this change, and which pages or documents are affected?

## Evidence for public claims

- [ ] No new product capability, metric, customer, certification, or compliance claim was introduced.
- [ ] Any new factual claim is supported by a source or approved artifact.
- [ ] Private-beta availability is not presented as general availability.
- [ ] Limitations and uncertainty are stated where relevant.

## Quality checks

- [ ] Links and navigation work.
- [ ] HTML remains semantic and accessible.
- [ ] Mobile layout and keyboard behavior were considered for visual changes.
- [ ] Images have descriptive alt text and appropriate usage rights.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, customer data, or proprietary implementation details were added.
- [ ] Security-sensitive reports were not placed in a public issue or pull request.
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-public-repo.mjs` passes, or any failure is explained with evidence.
- [ ] New or edited documents were rebuilt with `node scripts/build-docs.mjs`, are linked from the documentation index, and relative links resolve.
- [ ] Public wording uses the approved autonomous description and its fixed definition from `CLAIMS.md` (no "fully autonomous", "hands-free", or "no human needed").
- [ ] Benchmark and capability language follows the relevant publication/evaluation policy.

## Visual evidence

Add before/after screenshots for material visual changes, or explain why screenshots are not applicable.
